ChatToolSelection.description: What a person keeps for one chat. Servers and Codex skills use an off list, so a new item is on. Claude skills use an allowlist.

account.description: The extra account of the choice. Absent means the own login of the user.

claudeSkills.description: Claude only. Absent or null keeps each skill. A list keeps only the named skills, and an empty list keeps none.

codexAppsOff.description: Codex only: leave out `codex_apps`, the bundle of every app.

codexSkillsOff.description: Codex only: skills to leave out, by their `skills/list` name.

serversOff.description: MCP servers to leave out, by the exact name that the harness uses.

ClaudeSkillChoice.description: The Claude skills that a chat keeps. Names are as the init message gives them: a bare name, or `plugin:skill` for a plugin skill.

expectedRevision.description: 0 for the first choice of a chat.
